jobs.title: Assistant GIS Specialist 3
jobs.description:
GAI Consultants is seeking an Associate GIS Specialist to join our team. This position is fully remote and can report out of any of our 22 office locations.

**Job Duties:**

* A successful candidate will provide GIS support to a variety of energy sectors through the development of maps, databases, and spatial analyses.
* The Assistant GIS Specialist 3 will be expected to work in the Esri software platform (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and ArcGIS Online) and be knowledgeable in the core environmental services that GAI offers its clients, such as wetland and stream delineation, state and federal permitting, and sensitive species surveys.
* Assists with publishing and managing Enterprise GIS content, such as feature services and web maps, and configuring web apps.

**Education:**

* BS or better in Environmental & Earth Science or related
* BS or better in Geography or related

**Experience:**

**Required:**

* Intermediate-level technical skills working with the Esri products suite, including ArcGIS Desktop/Pro with 3D Analyst & Spatial Analyst Extensions, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise (Portal), and other GIS software such as Google Earth Pro.
* Intermediate-level experience publishing and managing feature services and using ArcGIS Online/Enterprise to develop and share web maps for use in Field Maps, Web AppBuilder, etc.
* Understands how Esri’s Offline Maps workflow functions and demonstrates an ability to author and share web maps for offline use.
* Understands basic Enterprise (SDE) Geodatabase functionality and data administration workflows.

**Preferred:**

* 3-4 years minimum of professional GIS experience
* Experience in developing, publishing, and managing forms and surveys using Survey123 for ArcGIS a plus.

**Technical Responsibilities:**

* Develops geospatial data (digitizing), maps (PDF), and performs intermediate-level data analysis tasks. Performs data entry and formatting tasks (MS Excel).
* Demonstrates ability to identify geoprocessing workflows (i.e., a series of tools and/or operations) to solve basic geospatial questions.
* Shares web layers to Enterprise (Portal) and develops basic web maps and apps.
* Demonstrates ability to assist technical leaders with geodatabase design.
* Adherence to GAI GIS standards; learns to perform quality checks for entry level technical staff.

**“Why GAI?”**

GAI offers an exceptional place to do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a real impact in communities nationwide. You’ll join a collaborative, multidisciplinary firm bringing together engineering, planning, and environmental expertise to deliver projects across transportation, infrastructure, power, and energy markets. Working alongside accomplished colleagues, you’ll help move projects from vision through construction, creating solutions that keep people moving, power essential systems, and support responsible development.

At GAI, you’ll work in a team-driven environment grounded in integrity, respect, and shared success, with the flexibility, resources, and career support that reflect a real and lasting commitment to our people. That commitment includes comprehensive benefits, wellness programs, and employee discounts. With opportunities across the U.S., GAI offers the collaboration and client focus of regional teams, supported by the stability, resources, and career-development opportunities of an established and growing firm.

  

**Benefits To Working at GAI Include:**

**Competitive Pay & Recognition**

* Market based, competitive compensation
* Performance driven recognition and development bonuses

**Comprehensive Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Company-paid short-term and long-term disability
* Company-paid life insurance
* Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources

**Meaningful Work–Life Balance**

* Generous paid time off + 7 paid holidays
* An additional floating holiday—use it for what matters to you
* Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave

**Growth, Learning & Financial Security**

* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Support and rewards for professional development and certifications

Preferred

* Bachelors or better in Geography or related field

#### **Licenses & Certifications**

Required

* Driver's License

jobs.title: Sr. Geospatial Analyst - DHS
jobs.description:
cFocus Software seeks a Jr. Geospatial Analyst to join our program supporting the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). This position is remote. This position requires a Public Trust Clearance.  
  
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Geography or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant professional, internship, academic, military, or project experience in GIS, geospatial analysis, cartography, data management, or location intelligence.
* SME experience using ESRI technology such as ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise/Portal, ArcGIS Online, web maps, hosted feature layers, Dashboards, or comparable GIS tools.
* Understanding of spatial data concepts, coordinate systems, projections, geocoding, vector and raster data, attributes, metadata, data quality, and basic spatial analysis.
* Ability to work with common tabular, JSON, web-service, and geospatial formats and to organize and validate data systematically.
* Basic experience with Python, ArcGIS Notebooks, SQL, Arcade, or another scripting/query language used for data processing or GIS automation.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical reasoning, documentation, organization, communication, and willingness to learn in a collaborative Agile environment.
* Ability to satisfy DHS suitability, background-investigation, Entry on Duty, security, and system-access requirements for the assigned position.

**Duties:**

* Acquire, receive, organize, process, update, and maintain geospatial and operational datasets supporting DHS GMO mission programs.
* Prepare data for upload, publication, visualization, analysis, sharing, archival, and retrieval within ESRI Portal, ArcGIS Online, GII repositories, and other approved environments.
* Perform routine geoprocessing, spatial analysis, data conversion, coordinate validation, field mapping, joins, selections, overlays, and other assigned GIS production activities.
* Query and maintain archived geospatial information in open, accessible, and available standards and support applicable data backup, recovery, and records-retention activities.
* Follow established naming conventions, folder and repository structures, versioning practices, access restrictions, and data-handling procedures
* Perform data-quality assurance and quality-control checks for completeness, accuracy, consistency, currency, schema compliance, geometry, attribution, duplication, and usability.
* Document data-quality findings, corrections, assumptions, limitations, source lineage, and unresolved issues; escalate material concerns to senior staff.
* Create and maintain dataset, service, and database metadata in accordance with DHS geospatial methodologies, approved standards, and program procedures.
* Assist with database metadata design, repository maintenance, data dictionaries, field definitions, source descriptions, terms of use, points of contact, and update schedules.
* Support reconciliation of published layers, web services, source data, metadata, and related documentation so that information remains accurate and traceable.
* Design, configure, publish, and maintain web maps, hosted layers, and geospatial services under established technical and governance procedures.
* Configure appropriate symbology, labeling, pop-ups, filters, fields, scales, legends, and other presentation settings to meet user and mission requirements.
* Create and update ArcGIS Dashboards that present real-time information, key performance indicators, status, trends, and operational context.
* Assist with Experience Builder applications and other ESRI web experiences by configuring maps, widgets, data sources, layouts, and user-facing content.
* Validate that published products display accurate information, perform as expected, and support applicable accessibility, security, and user requirements
* Participate in requirements discussions and translate stakeholder data, mapping, visualization, and reporting needs into documented Jira stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and data specifications.
* Execute assigned manual and automated test cases for data workflows, maps, layers, dashboards, services, and geospatial applications; record results and document defects.
* Support user acceptance, integration, regression, data-quality, and operational testing and verify that corrections meet defined requirements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and retrospectives; keep assigned work and blockers current in Jira.
* Use Confluence, GitLab, and other Government-approved tools to maintain documentation, scripts, configuration items, decisions, and work products
